title: Identify all carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one oxygen atom p
question: Identify all carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one oxygen atom participating in a double bond. For each such molecule, return its ID, whether it is carcinogenic (as 'YES'), and the total number of distinct elements present in the molecule.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    m.XCL_010,
    'YES' AS carcinogenic,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_003) AS distinct_elements
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom ao
    JOIN bond b ON ao.XCL_002 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE ao.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
      AND ao.XCL_003 = 'o'
      AND b.XCL_006 = '='
  )
GROUP BY m.XCL_010

SELECT
    m.XCL_010,
    'YES' AS carcinogenic,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_003) AS distinct_elements
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom ao
    JOIN bond b ON ao.XCL_002 = b.XCL_005
    WHERE ao.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
      AND ao.XCL_003 = 'o'
      AND b.XCL_006 = '='
  )
GROUP BY m.XCL_010
